verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state users can 'follow an agent's progress live, send a correction while it's working, or queue up its next task,' and agents 'pause to ask questions' while retaining conversation history across sessions, directly matching the story of steering an active session without restarting. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that mid-task corrections actually alter agent behavior (community threads focus on UI/pricing, not steering mechanics).
